notes.title: Demo Available Now
notes.content:
Experience the Thrill of Planetary Strike

Prepare for a chess-like spacefaring adventure. We are excited to announce the launch of the Planetary Strike Demo, now available for download on Steam! 

Command a Fleet As a Commander, guide your fleet through intense space battles against formidable opponents, showcasing your strategic prowess and tactical skills.

Unveil The Story Immerse yourself in a gripping single-player campaign with a visual novel like story. Explore the galaxy and meet interesting characters.

Make Choices That Matter Shape the course of your journey by making choices that truly alter the trajectory of the narrative.

Download and play the demo today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2604720/Planetary_Strike_Demo?snr=1_7_15__13


We appreciate your support and feedback as we continue to refine and enhance Planetary Strike for its full-fledged release! We hope you enjoy the demo.

- Claim to Fame Games
